name: Sticky CTA Button
author: Desk9 Design

sections.description:
Sticky CTA Button is a WordPress plugin that adds a customizable floating CTA (Call-to-Action) button and back-to-top button to your website. The plugin offers extensive customization options including:

  • Flexible positioning – Choose from 4 corner positions
  • Custom styling – Set your own colors, icons, and text
  • Automatic combination – When both buttons are enabled, they’re automatically combined
  • Responsive design – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Accessibility – Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support
  • Performance optimized – Lightweight and fast loading

Features

  • Action Button: Create a call-to-action button with custom text, icon, and link
  • Back-to-Top Button: Smooth scrolling back to top with customizable icons
  • Smart Layout: Buttons automatically combine when both are enabled
  • Icon Library: Choose from 16+ Font Awesome icons for each button
  • Color Customization: Set custom background and text colors
  • Position Control: Place buttons in any corner of the screen
  • Layout Options: Vertical or horizontal combined layouts
  • Rounded Corners: Optional rounded corner styling
  • Mobile Responsive: Automatically adapts to smaller screens
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sticky-cta-button directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Sticky CTA Button screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I customize the button appearance?

Go to Settings > Sticky CTA Button in your WordPress admin. You can customize colors, text, icons, and positioning from there.

Can I use both buttons at the same time?

Yes! When both the action button and back-to-top button are enabled, they automatically combine into a single elegant unit.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin is fully responsive and automatically adjusts for mobile devices.

Does it affect site performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only loads necessary resources when buttons are enabled.
